name: evently
description: Evently – scalable event ticketing platform (microservices + React frontend)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n auth,catalog,booking,notify,gateway,web -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan,white "npm:dev -w @evently/auth-service" "npm:dev -w @evently/catalog-service" "npm:dev -w @evently/booking-service" "npm:dev -w @evently/notify-service" "npm:dev -w @evently/gateway" "npm:dev -w @evently/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w @evently/gateway && npm test -w @evently/booking-service
